data.narrative:
SandboxAQ, a Series E AI & Software company founded by Jack Hidary, has raised $950M+ and carries a last post-money valuation of $5.75B. The relevant comp universe spans 9 private frontier-tech peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir), all operating in the AI & Software sector at or near the Series E stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the company's $5.8B last post-money valuation and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement, implies a forward valuation of $8.0B. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Palantir ($312.5B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Ayar Labs ($3.8B). The median across these three is $10.0B, though the range reflects significant dispersion.

Synthesizing both methods yields a triangulated range of $6.8B (low) to $11.5B (high), with a median of $9.0B. This range sits materially above the current $5.75B mark, suggesting potential upside in a subsequent funding round. Key uncertainties include the extreme outlier valuation of Palantir relative to Crusoe and Ayar Labs, which widens peer comparability and introduces material range sensitivity. Stage-progression assumptions and the timing of Series E-to-later-stage advancement further constrain precision around point estimates within the $6.8B–$11.5B band.
